messages:
anya: quick proposal — add a lightweight response header that signals routing outcome to clients so console can show 'why' a request was degraded/fallback/throttled. thinking header name: `x-rw-route-status` with coarse values like served|degraded|fallback|throttled.

jordan: ok interesting. are we planning to map those to HTTP status codes or keep 200 + header? worried about cached clients expecting non-200.

sam: :thinking_face: exposing routing outcome seems useful for UX but could leak capacity/quota details. also might encourage customers to hardcode behavior on our internal variants. can we sanitize values?

maria: agree we need a hygiene plan. proposal: header gives category only (served/degraded/fallback/throttled/blocked). detailed reason lives in telemetry and console (internal-only reason codes like Q1, NODE_FAIL, VERSION_MISMATCH). also include `Retry-After` when throttled.

anya: example header format I had in mind:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-rw-route-status: fallback;variant=llama-13b;reason=quota
content-type: application/json
```
We could make `variant` optional; reason should be a short token if present. SDKs should expose the header as `routeStatus` and map to client-facing copy.

jordan: how would this interact with our error taxonomy? e.g., some fallbacks are transient vs terminal. Console should show appropriate remediation hints. We need telemetry tag `route_outcome` to count outcomes by route/model/tenant.

sam: I still want to avoid encouraging clients to treat header as retry hint. We should add a line in the contract: header is informational only; actionable retry hint is explicit `Retry-After` or `x-rw-action: retryable|not-retryable`.

maria: for dashboards we want more granularity than header allows. suggestion: header remains coarse for clients; internal metrics include `route_outcome_reason` (detailed token), `route_fallback_variant`, and `route_latency_bucket`. console can join those into the UX badge and show a tooltip with sanitized reason text.

anya: sounds like convergence: 1) coarse header for clients (served|degraded|fallback|throttled|blocked), 2) explicit Retry-After / x-rw-action for retries, 3) richer internal telemetry with sanitized reason tokens surfaced in console. I'll draft RFC with mapping table and sample SDK behaviors.

jordan: +1 to RFC. include rollout guidance: new header should be behind a 2-week beta flag for customers on dedicated/private, and enabled gradually for hosted.

sam: +1 but add security review: make sure no tenant-specific capacity numbers leak (no raw node ids, quotas, or percent util in header).

maria: I'll own the console mapping doc and the tooltip copy. also want a signal in evaluations when a model variant is routinely used as fallback so product can consider upgrading default.

deploy-bot: deploy finished: rollout/routing-header -> canary 10%

anya: great — I'll open RFC + PR for telemetry tags and SDK guidelines. tagging @maria @sam for reviews. :thumbsup:
